rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 401 OF THE TARIFF AND CUSTOMS CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, AS AMENDED(RE: PROTECTS LOCAL PRODUCERS WITH REGARDS TO REDUCTION OF CERTAIN TARIFF LEVELS)
rows.abstract: Rationale: While it is incumbent upon the Tariff Commission to recommend to the President the reduction of certain tariff levels, it should be done WITHOUT BIAS to our local producers. The Commission should see to it that the affected local producers are informed of any public hearing which conerns them and that they are heard and given sufficient time to present their side. Industries located far from Metro Manila, ofter complain of not being able to present their case against their foreign competitors, may be given special treatment insofar as notice of public hearings and submission of evidence is concerned.  To provide addition protection to local manufacturers, this bill proposed the submission to Congress of the result of all investiigations conducted by the Tariff Commission, including findings and/or recommendations .

rows.abstract: It shall be unlawful for any person to oeprate at all times any protable electronic devices which tansmits radio signals while in the aircraft. These include, but are not limited, to amateur radio transceivers, citizens band radios, pagers, cellularphones, text messaging devices, remote control devices, other electronic devices and all other types of portable radio transceivers, whose operation in flight, the carrier or commercial operator herafter determines may likewise endanger the safety of flight. An aircarft is in flight from the moment all its external doors are closed following embarkation until any of such doors are opened for disembarkation.

rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTALLING A REGIONAL GOVERNMENT UNDER A GOVERNOR TO ADMINISTER THE AFFAIRS OF THE NATIONAL CAPITAL REGION (NCR) AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "An Act Installing a Regional Government Under a Governor to Adminsiter the Affairs of the National Capital Region". Rationale: In Metro Manila, policy relationship among the LGus just couldn't be reached because of the traditional mutual hostilityin place.  Each local official, endowed with a rugged spirit of independence - with a mind of his own, coupled with a strong mixed socio-economic and political porfolio - wouldn't just easily abdicate his authority. No doubt, the NCR has an overwhelming array of public problems that ignore boundary lines - pollution, poverty, transportation, land use, waste management and disposal, health, crime housing, urban renewal,w ater supply, electricity, etc. - PROBLMES OF REGIONAL DIMENSION. The presentt arrangement is an extreme example of an institutional lag which inhibits the area from arriving at a single solution for all to adopt in dealing with common problems and needs.

rows.author: B037
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO REGULATE THE CARRYING OF FIREARMS, PROVIDE PENALTIES FOR ITS VIOLATION AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Gun-bearing Act of 2000". Rationale: It is very important that the government regulate the use and carrying of firearms especially in public places to promote peace and security. This bill, therefore, advocates a clearer and more systematic processof regulating gun ownership and movement.  It pushes for the CONFISCATION of illegal firearms to help prevent the commission of crimes.  It also seeks to LIMIT the public carrying of firearms to agents of the Government who are responsible for maintaining peace and order.  On the other hand, it will not impair the privilege of citizens to keep licensed firearms at home for protection or at gun clubs for sports purposes.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SECURITY since 2000-05-08

As a matter of facy many families have been broken due to gambling.  On the other hand, it also helps build roads and bridges, schools, water system, and other forms of infrastructure projects from its proceeds. Its many advantages and disadvantages are still up for debate until this time because nobody knows exactly in factual terms if gambling indeed brings more harm than good.
